## Hungary, Slovenia and Croatia

Three new markets in the setup dialog: **Hungary (HU)**, **Slovenia (SI)**
and **Croatia (HR)**, all in euro, each on its own clock (Budapest,
Ljubljana, Zagreb), so time-of-day grid charges are read in local time.
That makes 37 price zones.

- **Hungary and Slovenia** show the real day-ahead prices once the auction
  is published, and our forecast for the hours after them.
- **Croatia** shows only our forecast, as Slovakia did at first. To see the
  real Croatian prices for today and tomorrow, add an
  [own price source](https://github.com/BackupBaTTerY/energypriceforecast-home-assistant#your-own-price-source-1210):
  the ENTSO-e integration covers Croatia.

Prices, the cheapest windows, the plans and the own retail formula work
there as in every other market. Two things fill in over the coming days,
without another update:

- **CO2 is not available for the three yet.** The CO2 entities, the
  cleanest-hours plan and the CO2 half of the combined score stay empty
  until the API delivers it.
- **Forecast quality appears after seven days** of forecasts, the same
  warm-up every market went through.

There is no retail estimate and no price spike hint for the three.

Every other market is unchanged.

**After updating, restart Home Assistant.** Reloading the integration is not
enough.
